full_prompt_en: A square, edge-to-edge illustrated cityscape rises in stacked layers from a narrow bright blue canal at the bottom to a dark blue night sky across the top. Dozens of small buildings press together, each simplified into a colorful facade with arched doors, tiny windows, balconies, and patterned roofs. Pale yellow, pink, orange, turquoise, and lavender walls alternate rapidly, so no single building dominates the composition. Taller cream-colored churches and towers punctuate the upper skyline, some capped by warm copper-colored domes and narrow finials. Between the walls, rounded green trees and flowering pink crowns fill gaps and break up the many straight edges. Small figures and decorative details appear along the waterfront and within the streets, but the city is read chiefly as a dense patchwork of buildings rather than one narrative event. The canal curls into the lower left and returns near the lower right, with an arched bridge and tiny boats suggested by a few dark and bright marks. At the upper edge, the sky is crowded with small white dots, multicolored stars, round colored lights, a yellow disk, and a thin crescent moon. Outlined shapes are deliberately compact and varied; facades overlap and climb upward without realistic perspective or a clean street grid. Black or very dark blue contours hold the countless saturated colors apart. The painted or printed surface has a slight grain and handmade irregularity, letting the repeated windows, roof tiles, flowers, and stars feel lively rather than mechanically uniform. The result is festive and exuberant, with a large amount of miniature detail held together by the uninterrupted deep-blue sky and repeating warm roofs.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、满幅的插画城市景观从底部狭窄的亮蓝运河层层堆高，直到顶部的深蓝夜空。数十座小楼挤在一起，每一栋都简化为色彩鲜明的立面，带拱门、小窗、阳台和有纹样的屋顶。浅黄、粉红、橙色、绿松石色与淡紫色墙面快速交替，因此没有一座建筑独占画面。较高的奶油色教堂和塔楼点缀上方天际线，有些覆着暖铜色圆顶和细窄尖饰。楼墙之间，圆形绿树和粉色花冠填满空隙，也打断了众多直线。临水处和街道间可见小人物及装饰细节，但城市首先呈现为密集的建筑拼布，而非某一个叙事事件。运河在左下弯入，又于右下附近回转，拱桥与小舟由少量明暗色点提示。上缘的天空布满白色小点、彩色星形、圆形光点、一枚黄色圆盘和一弯细月。带轮廓线的形状刻意紧凑多变，立面相互遮叠、向上攀升，并不遵循真实透视或整齐街网。黑色或极深蓝线条将大量饱和色彼此分开。绘制或印刷表面略带颗粒与手工不规则感，重复的窗格、瓦片、花朵和星光因此生动而不机械。整体欢快丰盛，海量微型细节靠连贯的深蓝天空和反复出现的暖色屋顶维系。
style_prompt_en: Hand-drawn, storybook-like illustration built from miniature outlined shapes packed almost continuously across the picture plane. The design favors stacked, overlapping layers and shallow perspective over a single realistic vanishing point. A dark blue ground and nearly black contour lines organize a vivid mosaic of pink, yellow, orange, mint, turquoise, and lavender. Rounded organic marks interrupt the many rectangular forms, and small dots, stars, arches, windows, and patterned bands create a constant decorative rhythm. Painted color can vary slightly within each area, with a light grain and uneven line weight that retain a handmade feel. Large dark areas give the eye a resting place while the remaining field rewards close inspection with small distinct motifs. Scale shifts are playful and compressed; the effect is busy but legible because repeated outlines and saturated color groups hold the whole arrangement together. Aim for exuberance, warmth, and childlike visual curiosity without smoothing away the irregular drawing.
style_prompt_zh: 手绘童话式插画由微小的描边形状构成，几乎连续铺满画面。设计偏向层叠、互相遮压的浅空间，而非单一真实灭点。深蓝底色和近黑轮廓线组织粉红、黄色、橙色、薄荷绿、绿松石色与淡紫色的鲜亮马赛克。圆润的有机色点打断大量矩形形体；小圆点、星形、拱形、窗格和花纹带形成持续的装饰节奏。每块填色可有轻微变化，细颗粒与不均匀线重保留手作感。大片深色为眼睛提供停歇之处，其余区域则以各异的小图案供人近看。尺度变化活泼而压缩；画面热闹却易辨读，因为反复出现的轮廓线和饱和色组将整体凝聚。气质丰盛、温暖、富于童稚的视觉好奇，保留线条的不规则。
theme_en: A densely packed, brightly colored storybook town beside a winding canal under a starry blue sky
theme_zh: 深蓝星空下，一座临蜿蜒运河的缤纷密集童话小城
name: James Rizzi
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
